title: QuidelOrtho Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
summary: QuidelOrtho develops and manufactures intelligent solutions that are transforming data into understanding and action for more people in more places every day, helping spot trends sooner, respond quicker and chart the course ahead with accuracy and confidence. body_text: SAN DIEGO , July 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL)("QuidelOrtho"), a leading global provider of diagnostic solutions, today announced that the Compensation Committee of the Company's Board of Directors approved the grant of restricted stock units ("RSUs") with respect to 356,555 shares of the Company's common stock (the "Inducement Grant") to Micah Young, the Company's Chief Financial Officer and principal financial officer. The Inducement Grant was granted pursuant to the Company's 2026 Inducement Plan and as an inducement material to Mr. Young's entering into employment with the Company in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). The 2026 Inducement Plan is used exclusively for the grant of equity awards to individuals who were not previously employees of QuidelOrtho, or following a bona fide period of non-employment, as an inducement material to such individuals entering into employment with QuidelOrtho, pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). The RSUs were granted with a grant date of July 15, 2026, and will vest in equal annual installments on the first three anniversaries of the grant date, subject to Mr. Young's continued employment with the Company through each applicable vesting date. The RSUs are subject to the terms and conditions of the 2026 Inducement Plan and the terms and conditions of a RSU award agreement covering the grant. QuidelOrtho is dedicated to advancing diagnostics to power a healthier future. For more information, please visit quidelortho.com and follow QuidelOrtho on LinkedIn, Facebook and X. About QuidelOrtho Corporation With expertise spanning clinical chemistry, immunoassay, immunohematology and molecular testing, QuidelOrtho Corporation (Nasdaq: QDEL) is a leading global provider of diagnostic solutions, dedicated to advancing fast, accurate and reliable results that help improve patient outcomes – from the point of care to hospital, lab to clinic. Building on a legacy of innovation, QuidelOrtho works with healthcare providers to advance diagnostics that connect insights with solutions, defining a clearer path for informed decisions and better care. body_text: Popular School Meals Face Changes to Reduce Sugar and Sodium School cafeterias across the United States may soon see changes to some of the meals students know and love. Foods such as pizza, tacos, chicken wings, breakfast smoothies, sausage biscuits, and other popular cafeteria choices may need healthier recipes to meet updated nutrition standards scheduled to take effect during the 2027 to 2028 school year. A recent study published in Nutrition Reviews found that many commonly served school meals contain high amounts of added sugar and sodium. Researchers say the goal is not to remove students’ favorite foods, but to improve their nutritional value while keeping meals enjoyable, familiar, and appealing. School meals play an important role in children’s daily nutrition. For many students, breakfast and lunch served at school provide some of the most balanced meals they receive throughout the day. Because many children eat these meals several times each week, even small improvements in ingredients and preparation methods could have a meaningful impact over time. Researchers Examine Common Cafeteria Foods The research team reviewed current school cafeteria offerings to understand which foods may require updates under upcoming United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) nutrition limits. Researchers surveyed nearly 1,100 school nutrition professionals to learn which foods schools serve most often and which meals students choose regularly. They then analyzed recipes for popular items to identify those with the highest levels of added sugar and sodium. The study found that several breakfast foods commonly served in schools may contain more sugar than recommended. Items such as muffins, yogurt parfaits, and breakfast smoothies were among the foods identified as higher in added sugars. Other breakfast choices, including sausage biscuits and breakfast pizzas, were found to contain significant amounts of sodium. At lunchtime, foods such as flavored chicken wings, tacos, and nachos were also identified as meals that may need recipe adjustments. One example highlighted by researchers was chicken wings. Some recipes averaged more than 2,100 milligrams of sodium per serving, which is close to the daily sodium limit of 2,300 milligrams recommended for adults. Healthier Recipes Without Removing Student Favorites Nutrition experts say improving school meals does not have to mean eliminating popular foods. Instead, schools can focus on creating healthier versions of familiar dishes. Researchers suggest that cafeteria professionals can reduce sodium by using herbs, spices, and other flavor-building ingredients. Garlic, rosemary, thyme, paprika, and other seasonings can enhance taste without relying heavily on salt. For sweet foods, ingredients such as cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger may help provide flavor while reducing dependence on added sugars. The challenge, however, is making sure students actually enjoy the updated meals. A healthier recipe will only succeed if students choose to eat it. Taste testing, student surveys, and feedback programs can help schools understand which changes work best. When students are involved in the process, cafeterias may have a better chance of creating meals that are both nutritious and popular. Why Reducing Sugar and Sodium Matters for Children Eating too much added sugar and sodium regularly can contribute to health concerns over time. Developing healthy eating habits during childhood can help children make better food choices as they grow older. School cafeterias are one environment where children are exposed to food choices repeatedly. Researchers say these daily experiences can influence what students consider normal and enjoyable. The goal is not to make school meals boring or restrictive. Instead, the focus is on helping children become comfortable with foods that are lower in sugar and sodium while still being flavorful. Experts emphasize that school meals are only one part of a child’s overall diet. Family meals, personal preferences, activity levels, and many other factors also influence long-term health. However, improving the quality of school meals can provide an additional opportunity to support children’s well-being. Schools Face the Challenge of Balancing Nutrition and Taste Updating cafeteria menus will require creativity from school nutrition teams. Food professionals must balance federal nutrition requirements with student expectations. A meal that meets nutrition standards but goes uneaten does not provide the intended benefits. This is why researchers stress the importance of maintaining familiar flavors and appealing textures while making gradual improvements. Small recipe changes can make a difference. Reducing sodium little by little, adjusting sweetness levels, and introducing new flavors can help students adapt to healthier versions of their favorite foods. Schools may also use education programs to help students understand why certain changes are being made. When children learn about nutrition and how food choices affect health, they may become more open to trying updated meals. The Future of School Cafeteria Food The upcoming nutrition standards represent an opportunity for schools to rethink cafeteria menus. Instead of viewing changes as restrictions, experts say they can be seen as a chance to improve the foods children eat every day. Popular meals do not have to disappear. With thoughtful recipe development, schools can continue serving foods students recognize while improving their nutritional quality. Researchers believe that exposing children to healthier meals consistently can help shape lifelong eating habits. While school food alone cannot determine a child’s future health, it can contribute to building a stronger foundation for better choices. As schools prepare for the updated USDA requirements, nutrition professionals will continue exploring ways to create meals that are healthier, satisfying, and enjoyable for students. Sources University of Mississippi news release, July 23, 2026. Nutrition Reviews , July 23, 2026. Medical Disclaimer Statistical information in medical and nutrition articles describes general trends and does not apply to every individual. Personal health needs can vary based on age, medical history, lifestyle, and other factors. Always seek advice from a qualified healthcare professional for personalized nutrition or health decisions.

title: My ’69 Corvette Was a Dream Fulfilled
summary: I saw my first Corvette in 1953, when I was 10 years old. body_text: I saw my first Corvette in 1953, when I was 10 years old. It was on display at the end-of-summer fair in Hookstown, Pennsylvania, parked in a tent alongside some sewing machines and refrigerators. What a beauty it was—I couldn’t take my eyes off it. I looked at it from every angle. I even got down on the ground and looked underneath. I gazed, for what seemed like hours, at my reflection in the chrome, and I knew someday that a new Corvette would be part of my life. The image of that car stuck in my mind, and I dreamed about it all the time. I read every article about the Corvette I could find. After I graduated from high school and was working, I started looking for a used Corvette, but none I looked at felt quite right. By 1969, I was working full-time and going to college at night. On Valentine’s Day, while taking a world history exam, I got an overwhelming urge to order a new Corvette . I hurried through the exam and then literally raced over to my Chevy dealer. Allen Lewarchik Allen Lewarchik Even before I walked through the door, I knew exactly what I wanted: It had to be a convertible, it had to be red inside and out, and the roof had to be black. I had seen this car in my mind and had run my hand over each and every inch of it. The salesman examined my current car, a ’64 Chevy Nova, and was eager to make a deal. It was in tip-top shape, with very low mileage, and he knew it wouldn’t last long on the lot. We haggled a bit and finally came to an arrangement, then I signed the deal and we shook hands. The salesman assured me my car would be here in 90 days, so when I got home, I grabbed the calendar and quickly marked off the date: May 15. May! Sunshine! Warm weather! Cruising with the top down! I could hardly wait. Allen Lewarchik May arrived, but no Corvette. Repeated calls to the salesman did little good—a strike had closed the St. Louis assembly plant. June, July, and August came and went, and great convertible weather was passing me by. Finally, though, on September 9, my red beauty arrived. I came home from work and found a sketch of a Corvette my mother had lovingly drawn, with a note that the salesman had called. The months of waiting were over, and I raced to the dealership. There it was: my Monza Red convertible. I raised the hood to admire the 350 cubic-inch, 300-horsepower V-8 . Then I signed the papers, handed over the keys to the Nova, and the salesman dropped the Corvette’s keys into my hand. I slid into the driver’s seat and headed for the open road. I took it through all four gears, and I could feel the 3:36 rear end slide around the curves. Allen Lewarchik Allen Lewarchik Allen Lewarchik Joy turned to grief, however, when I drove this beauty to my insurance agent… He had told me before I made the purchase that his company might not insure Corvettes. He tried to convince them to change their policy, but to no avail. Now I had my car and no insurance, so I canceled my policy and set out to find another insurance company. Thankfully, it was less of a problem that I’d feared, and the first three companies I called were ready and willing to insure me and the Corvette. Almost 57 years later, I still own this remarkable car. I still have all the original paperwork, Protect-O-Plate, and all “inside the car” operating instructions. Over the past several years, I’ve gone to local car shows and have won more than 50 trophies. In 1996, I had the car judged at the local NCRS chapter meet, where it received a Top Flight award. Ten years later, NCRS invited me to display it in the gallery at Corvettes at Carlisle. My C3 is part of me. When I sit and gaze at my reflection in the chrome, I can still see that wide-eyed 10-year-old with a dream of the “perfect machine.” Allen Lewarchik The post My ’69 Corvette Was a Dream Fulfilled appeared first on Hagerty Media .

title: POSCO Holdings announces Q2 2026 results… profitability improved on visible gains centered on lithium and LNG resources
body_text: POSCO Holdings announces Q2 2026 results… profitability improved on visible gains centered on lithium and LNG resources 2026/07/31 Mail facebook twitter linkedin Consolidated sales of KRW 19.259 trillion, operating profit of KRW 819 billion, and net profit of KRW 761 billion Results improved quarter-on-quarter across all segments, including steel, secondary battery materials, and energy POSCO-Argentina successfully turned profitable in Q2… POSCO Future M’s profitability recovered on cathode material inventory valuation gains and increased anode material sales POSCO International posted a record quarterly operating profit on stronger lng and palm oil earnings… POSCO E&C maintained a solid trend through expanded orders in its building business POSCO Holdings announced on July 30 consolidated results for the second quarter of 2026, posting sales of KRW 19.259 trillion, operating profit of KRW 819 billion, and net profit of KRW 761 billion. Despite a worsening business environment caused by Middle East energy supply chain risks and a strong won trend, POSCO Holdings continued its improvement momentum, with consolidated sales and profit increasing since the fourth quarter of last year, led by a turnaround in the secondary battery materials segment and strong performance in the infrastructure business segment. In the steel segment, POSCO slightly increased sales and operating profit quarter-on-quarter, supported by higher selling prices and sales volume despite rising raw material costs and oil prices. In the secondary battery materials segment, POSCO Future M improved operating profit quarter-on-quarter thanks to cathode material inventory valuation gains and a recovery in sales volume of anode materials to major customers. In addition, POSCO-Argentina achieved its first quarterly turnaround to profit through stabilized operations at its first salt-lake lithium plant and equipment improvements. In the second half of the year, the completion of the second plant is expected to increase initial operating costs, but the company plans to improve profitability through phased production increases and expanded sales. POSCO Pilbara Lithium Solution improved earnings through expanded sales and higher prices, while POSCO HY Clean Metal has been posting monthly profits since December 2025 thanks to high utilization and enhanced cost competitiveness. In the infrastructure segment, POSCO International achieved its highest-ever quarterly operating profit, as profits from its Myanmar and Australian gas fields and Indonesia palm business all continued to grow. POSCO E&C defended profitability through improved earnings in its building business. POSCO Holdings has also revised upward its restructuring targets under the corporate restructuring program implemented since 2024, raising the goal from completing 128 transactions by 2027 and generating KRW 2.8 trillion in cash to completing 129 transactions by 2028 and generating KRW 3.5 trillion in cash. In the first half of this year, POSCO Holdings secured about KRW 480 billion in cash through 12 restructuring transactions, bringing cumulative restructuring to 85 transactions and total cash generation to KRW 2.2 trillion. Based on first-half achievements including a turnaround to profit in the lithium business, start-up of POSCO Gwangyang Works’ new electric arc furnace, and POSCO International’s record quarterly operating profit, POSCO Holdings plans to enhance profitability and pursue strategic investments in parallel, following its triple core strategy of industrial resources (steel), strategic resources (lithium, rare earths, rare gases, etc.), and energy resources (LNG, etc.), thereby continuing to grow corporate value. title: 8 Best Free AI Sales Tools We Tested in 2026
summary: Discover the 8 best free AI sales tools we actually tested in 2025. Boost outreach, automate workflows, and improve sales productivity with zero cost.
body_text: AI sales tools aren't just fancy add-ons for tech-savvy companies anymore. They've become crucial for sales success. The adoption rate is skyrocketing, with more than 40% of sales professionals already using AI. The data speaks volumes. AI-powered sales operations generate 50% more leads and achieve 391% higher conversion rates. Sales reps love it too - 80% of them say AI makes it easier to get customer insights they need to close deals. The market has exploded with over 1,300 AI sales tools, which can make choosing the right one a real challenge. We've tackled this challenge head-on. Our team has tested numerous free AI sales tools to find ones that deliver real results without breaking the bank. These tools can boost your lead volume by 50% and push conversion rates up by 25% when you use them right. Here's the good news - you won't need deep pockets to start. Many top-tier AI sales platforms come with feature-rich free versions that can change your team's performance. Our tests show these tools help sales teams spend 43% more time selling instead of pushing papers. Let's take a closer look at 8 free AI sales tools that passed our strict testing criteria and can help your team hit their 2025 targets. Trellus.AI Trellus.AI is revolutionizing cold calling with its AI-first sales engagement platform . This lightweight Chrome extension blends with your CRM system and helps your sales team connect with prospects better . Trellus.AI Key Features The platform has powerful AI capabilities that boost your team's productivity and call quality: Parallel Dialing : Your representatives can reach up to 5 prospects at once. This eliminates waiting time and triples call volume without quality loss. Real-Time AI Coaching : The system watches conversation patterns during live calls and suggests ways to handle objections better. Conversation Analysis : The AI engine spots speech patterns, sentiment, and engagement levels to learn about how prospects react. LinkedIn Superhuman : You can manage LinkedIn and Sales Navigator messages in one place, so no potential connection gets missed. Call Analytics : Track and score team performance to spot gaps between top and bottom performers. On top of that, it creates call summaries, follow-up emails, and prospect research. Your team can spend more time talking to potential clients. Trellus.AI Best Use Cases We found Trellus.AI works best with teams that focus on outbound sales strategies. The tool shines when you have: Sales teams that use cold calling as their main growth channel Companies that want better conversion rates through quality conversations Teams looking to triple their daily outreach while keeping it personal Businesses that want to cut down research time per prospect from 15 minutes to less than one The platform's sales floor feature recreates a relaxed office environment for remote teams. This helps sales departments build a shared calling culture. Trellus.AI Pricing The platform has different pricing tiers for various team sizes: Free Plan : $0/month - You get unlimited call recordings and transcription, AI-generated follow-up emails, call summaries, prospect research, and 30 free power dials weekly. Power Plan : $59.99/month - Single-line dialing, VM drop on select platforms, and LinkedIn Superhuman come with this plan. Parallel Plan : $149.99/month - You get multi-line dialing, VM drop on all platforms, unlimited AI practice calls, and 5 extra phone numbers with spam protection. Business Plan : Custom pricing - This includes customizable AI research, team-based analytics, and tailored reporting. Annual billing gives you big discounts on all paid plans. Why We Like Trellus.AI Our extensive testing shows that Trellus.AI delivers what it promises. Sales representatives can have better conversations with prospects while working faster. The real-time coaching feature stands out. It gives useful guidance during calls instead of just analyzing them later. Your team gets better with every conversation through this immediate feedback. Trellus.AI stands out by mixing automation with human skills. It does more than just connect calls - it works with representatives to make them better. One user said, "After using Trellus I've gotten so used to prospects picking up the phone that I can never go back". Sales teams looking to modernize their outreach while keeping the human touch will find Trellus.AI hits the sweet spot. The free tier lets teams of any size try it before buying a paid plan. Sendspark Personalized video messages help sales teams stand out in today's crowded marketplace. Sendspark is an AI-powered video platform that helps sales teams cut through inbox clutter with customized videos for each prospect. Sendspark Key Features Sendspark has several powerful features that make customized video outreach quick and effective: AI-Powered Personalization : Record one base video and let Sendspark customize it with each prospect's name, company details, and website backgrounds Voice Cloning Technology : Clone your voice to create natural-sounding customized videos without re-recording Dynamic Video Backgrounds : Your videos automatically appear on prospects' website backgrounds to show immediate relevance Custom Landing Pages : Build branded video pages with calls-to-action, embedded calendars, and customized messaging for each recipient Detailed Analytics : See who watches your videos, their viewing duration, and their follow-up actions Bulk Video Generation : Transform one recording into hundreds or thousands of customized videos within minutes The platform blends with over 50 email platforms and CRMs including HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, and Zoho to fit right into your existing workflows. Sendspark Best Use Cases Our testing shows Sendspark works best in several key sales scenarios: Cold Email Enhancement : Customized video thumbnails in outreach emails boost open and response rates by up to 3x Post-Meeting Follow-ups : Video summaries after meetings help reduce no-shows and confirm key details Lead Re-engagement : Revive stalled conversations with customized video touchpoints Account Expansion : Reach existing customers with tailored videos that showcase additional solutions LinkedIn Prospecting : Boost connection requests with customized video messages ( 2x more LinkedIn replies reported by users) Teams using Sendspark see substantial improvements in engagement metrics. Some even achieved "the best sales day of the year" after their first video campaign. Sendspark Pricing Sendspark provides several pricing tiers to fit different team sizes: Solo : $49/month per seat ($39/month billed annually) - Has 100 AI minutes, dynamic backgrounds, and AI name personalization Growth : $99/month for 3 seats ($69/month billed annually) - Adds 250 AI minutes, multiple variables, and API/webhook access Team : $299/month for 10 seats ($199/month billed annually) - Has 1,000 AI minutes, guided workflow setup, and admin dashboard Business : $699/month for 25 seats ($499/month billed annually) - Provides 3,000 AI minutes, live support, and dedicated account management AI credits power the platform's personalization features like creating videos with dynamic backgrounds and custom greetings. Why We Like Sendspark After testing many video tools, Sendspark stands out clearly. We created customized videos for 50+ contacts in minutes instead of hours. The customized thumbnails with prospect names generated much higher open rates than standard emails. The platform's AI voice cloning technology sounds remarkably natural. Unlike other tools that produce robotic-sounding speech, Sendspark keeps voice inflection and tone while customizing content for each recipient. The platform sets up quickly with an accessible interface. The core team created effective customized videos within minutes, even those with basic technical skills. Companies using Sendspark see 3x higher email conversions than standard outreach methods. Sales teams struggling with cold outreach engagement gain a clear advantage in breaking through inbox fatigue. Sendspark provides an excellent mix of personalization, scale, and simplicity for teams looking to stand out in their outreach without spending too much extra time. Otter.ai Sales processes rely heavily on meetings. Otter.ai changes how we handle these conversations by turning them into applicable information through AI transcription. The platform captures, transcribes, and analyzes sales calls automatically. Your teams get detailed documentation and insights without doing manual work. Otter.ai Key Features Otter.ai has a strong set of tools that optimize the sales communication process: Real-Time Transcription : Automatically joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings to provide live transcription in English, French, and Spanish. AI-Generated Summaries : Creates automated live summaries during meetings and detailed meeting summaries afterward with automatically identified action items. Otter AI Chat : You can ask questions about meeting content in real-time without disrupting the conversation flow. Speaker Identification : Recognizes and labels different speakers and learns custom vocabulary including industry jargon and acronyms. Slide Capture : Adds slides and screen shares from your meetings into the transcript automatically to give complete context. Sales teams can use Otter.ai's Sales Agent feature to extract key sales insights , write follow-up emails, and sync call notes directly to Salesforce or HubSpot. The platform also has live coaching features that spot objections, competitor mentions, and pricing discussions during calls. Otter.ai Best Use Cases Our testing shows Otter.ai works well in many sales scenarios: The tool is a great way to get help if you need to stay focused during client conversations. A VP of Sales shared, "Going from watching a recording and going back and taking notes, playing it, pausing it, versus Otter—the workflow is so much better". New team members can benefit from it as an onboarding tool. Otter's centralized knowledge hub lets new sales staff review summaries of past client interactions quickly. They can get up to speed in minutes instead of weeks. Team collaboration during sales calls becomes easier. Your team can connect with internal experts who aren't in the meeting and get answers to prospect questions before the meeting ends. Sales leaders can coach their teams better by reviewing transcripts. This helps them assess their reps' progress and improve their sales pitches. Otter.ai Pricing Otter.ai's pricing comes in tiers to fit different needs: Basic Plan (Free) : Has 300 monthly transcription minutes with a 30-minute per conversation limit. Features include Zoom, MS Teams, and Google Meet integration, AI Chat, live transcription, speaker identification, and 3 lifetime audio/video file imports. Pro Plan : USD 16.99/user/month , with 1,200 monthly transcription minutes, 90 minutes per meeting, 10 monthly audio/video imports, advanced search capabilities, and unlimited storage. Business Plan : USD 30.00/user/month, gives you unlimited meetings and in-app recordings, unlimited audio/video imports, up to 4 hours per meeting, enhanced admin features, and the ability to join 3 concurrent meetings. Enterprise Plan : Custom pricing includes unlimited custom AI workflows, Otter Sales Notetaker, custom CRM integrations, single sign-on, enterprise-grade security, and HIPAA compliance. Students and educators get 20% off Pro plans with .edu email addresses. Why We Like Otter.ai Our thorough testing revealed significant time savings and workflow improvements. One company found their team became "33% more effective, getting 33% time back". Otter.ai does more than just record meetings. It creates a searchable, shareable knowledge base. The platform extracts sales insights automatically and syncs them to CRM systems, which eliminates manual data entry. Small teams and individuals can start improving their sales processes with the free tier. The paid tiers quickly pay for themselves through time savings and better information management. We were impressed by how Otter.ai works as an "interconnected hub of knowledge" for sales teams. It connects prospect conversations with internal teams seamlessly throughout the sales cycle. Seamless.AI Sales teams face a huge challenge - finding accurate prospect data. Seamless.AI solves this problem with a detailed AI-powered search engine that finds verified B2B contact details through up-to-the-minute data analysis. Seamless.AI Key Features Seamless.AI has powerful tools that make prospecting more efficient: Real-Time Data Verification : Seamless.AI doesn't rely on old databases. It searches and verifies contact details right when you need to reach decision-makers. Comprehensive Contact Search : You get access to over 1.3 billion B2B contacts with full profiles that have emails, phone numbers, and direct dials. Buyer Intent Data : You can spot and focus on prospects who actively look for solutions like yours. The platform tracks more than 12,000 topics. Job Changes Tracker : The system alerts you when contacts switch roles. This helps you reach out during their first 100 days - when buyers typically spend 70% of their budget. Autopilot Prospecting : The system builds lists automatically, like in "Tesla's autopilot but for prospecting". Data Enrichment : Your contact information stays fresh and updated, which helps tackle the 70% annual decay rate you see in regular databases. The platform's Chrome extension lets you build prospect lists right from any website you visit. Seamless.AI Best Use Cases Seamless.AI shines in several key areas: Sales teams love using it to build targeted prospect lists based on specific criteria like industry, job title, company size, or technologies used. This focused approach helps teams reach the right opportunities. The platform does a great job of enriching existing CRM data. Teams upload their contact lists and the system fills in missing details and updates old records automatically. Account-based marketing strategies work better with Seamless.AI. Teams can find and connect with multiple decision-makers in target companies. The platform helps sales teams track their valuable customers' job changes. This feature maintains relationships and uncovers new opportunities when contacts move to different companies. Seamless.AI Pricing Seamless.AI uses a credit-based pricing system with different tiers: Free Plan : You get 50 lifetime credits with access to verified emails and cell phones. Basic Plan : Costs $147/month and includes 250 monthly credits per user. Pro Plan : Custom pricing that comes with 1,000+ daily credits for five or more licenses. Enterprise Plan : Custom solutions with no limits. Each time you look up contact details, it uses one credit. Teams can add extra features like Buyer Intent Data, Job Changes tracking, and Data Enrichment at additional cost. Why We Like Seamless.AI Our detailed testing shows that Seamless.AI delivers great results. The data accuracy really stands out from other tools. Email accuracy hits about 85% , though phone numbers aren't quite as reliable. Better accuracy means more productive outreach and less wasted time. The platform's up-to-the-minute search approach beats traditional databases. Instead of using old information, Seamless.AI searches the web right away to find current contact details. The tool connects smoothly with popular CRMs and sales tools. This makes it easy to fit into your current workflow. The free tier lets teams try AI prospecting without spending money upfront . You get 50 free credits to verify how well the platform works before buying a paid plan. Regular prospecting takes hours of manual research. Seamless.AI automates this process and saves significant time. Teams that focus on outbound sales should think about adding this tool to their AI-enhanced sales stack. SalesBlink SalesBlink makes email campaigns work better for sales success through AI-powered automation that handles everything from creation to follow-up. This detailed sales outreach platform helps make cold email campaigns more effective while saving time. SalesBlink Key Features SalesBlink has several standout features that boost email outreach: BlinkGPT AI : You can create customized multi-step email sequences based on your business description and target audience. The AI generates compelling templates and follow-ups that launch within minutes when you describe your needs. Email WarmUp : Your sender reputation grows automatically through gradual interactions with real inboxes. This ensures your cold emails land in primary inboxes instead of spam folders. Meeting Scheduler : A shareable link lets prospects book meetings based on your availability. The system syncs calendars and manages time zones automatically.
